item.title: Bill would require Kansas schools to stock naloxone, provide fentanyl prevention education
item.description: BY MAYA SMITHKansas Reflector TOPEKA — Parents, first responders and educators are urging lawmakers to require schools to stock naloxone and provide fentanyl prevention education to prevent overdoses and deaths. House Bill 2489 would combine education and resources with the goal of preventing youth fentanyl-related deaths. Schools would be required to maintain a stock supply […]

item.title: ASKING ERIC: Best friend doesn’t return texts; the new normal?
item.description: Dear Eric: I have had a best friend, Beth. I’ve known her since we were 23 years old. We have not always lived in the same city nor seen each other regularly, but when we do, it’s as if no time or distance has passed. We connect immediately.
